summary.en: Adjoining a number i whose square is −1 extends the real numbers to the complex numbers a + bi, in which every polynomial equation has a solution and arithmetic still works exactly as before.
summary.et: Arvu i lisamine, mille ruut on −1, laiendab reaalarvud kompleksarvudeks kujul a + bi, milles igal polünoomvõrrandil on lahend ja aritmeetika toimib täpselt nagu varem.
